title: Before You Travel: Five Steps
gist_ar: خمس خطوات لازم تعملها قبل السفر.
text: Are you going to travel next month? Follow these five steps. First, save money every week. Second, book your flight early, because tickets are cheaper. Third, choose a hotel near the city centre. Fourth, make a list of the clothes you are going to need. Finally, check your passport two weeks before you travel. Do not wait until the last day! If you are going to stay abroad for a long time, learn ten words in the local language. Write your plan on paper and put it on your wall.
